briefdescription.para: Polymorphic eviction policy base and implementations with move semantics.

detaileddescription.para:
0.1.0
Maturity: 🟡 BETA
Gap Categories: CWE-672 (use-after-free), CWE-457 (uninitialized variable)
Provides:
Polymorphic eviction strategy interface
Move-enabled policy objects
Policy state tracking and moved-from detection
Multiple concrete strategies (LRU, LFU, FIFO, ARC)
